steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... I didn't mean to... I...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The fog has dispersed.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: We've received communications from the L.G.D. They found more Reunion movements.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They're currently tracking down one enemy, described as female with white hair--

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Amiya, Ch'en told me that she wanted you to...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...You don't look so good.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'll leave her to you, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It'd be ideal to leave within 5 minutes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}...

options: ...Do you not like this power you have?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... it's not like I'm afraid or anything...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course, I'm afraid... of losing you again... That's why...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just... didn't mean to...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... I just don't know...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't know if I should be saying this, but...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It shouldn't... only be hurting other people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't want you to see me like this, up close...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I took someone's life.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I feel no regret.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, what I mean is...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will always use my power for your sake. No matter what kind of burden he was carrying, I don't regret killing him.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... there should have been a better way.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He died because... I wasn't able to find it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And that... is eating me up inside.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't want...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't want you to see this side of me, {@nickname}.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even though I've always talked about freeing the Infected from pain and suffering...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But when matters the most, I have to persuade myself, again and again, that it's justified to take the life of another Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I am truly pathetic.

options: Amiya, at least you protected me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...This was my duty.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I never believed that anything was already determined by fate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, no matter what happens... no matter what I become...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll always protect you, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I promise.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You all go first!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I need to... I need to bring Skullshatterer back!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Are you insane?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: That's suicide... If you're going, we're all going together!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: All right!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I can't leave him alone out there...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Let's go then!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Why...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Why is Reunion... turning back around?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What are they doing...?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Hoshiguma! Fall back!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: L.G.D., don't panic!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Prepare for enemy attack!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Cover! Cover me!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: That woman...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: It's impossible... We can't get past her shield!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Quick! Wrap around, before they have a chance to react...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We have to get to Skullshatterer... and bring him...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: And bring him home!!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Rhodes Island! They're changing their target, watch out!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh no!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Hoshiguma! Watch your right!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hehe, you managed to block that? That's a bit interesting...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: An explosion? Another Reunion ambush?!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Not just that, of course~

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'd like you to behave yourself and stay put right here. Don't think about turning back, all right?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Tsk... Where the hell did you come from?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Again with those explosives...!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Amiya! I'm getting bombarded by Reunion!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Their forces are currently headed your way!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hmm, that shield of yours is pretty sturdy.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Seems like I've gotten myself into a bit of trouble...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Whatever, I'll just treat it like I'm doing Reunion a little favor.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Show me something entertaining. Make sure you don't let me down~

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's the 'W' person who we saw at Chernobog!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Could she... have managed to shake off Madam Ch'en? !

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Be careful of the enemy assault! We've got to help Madam Hoshiguma right away!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are many more enemies hiding nearby!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We won't be able to get the upper hand unless we reveal them!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor! Please lead our squads and hold off the enemy assault!
